# Local dependency source

`llm-guard/` contains the local fork at commit
`31d7a16964ba68bae6e00650c96d32538b1fe764` (version 0.3.16).
The original source, README, and MIT LICENSE are included. The working tree was
clean when captured. Runtime source is unchanged. Two upstream credential
fixtures have been sanitized in both the source tree and
`llm-guard-31d7a169.zip`; see [SANITIZATION.md](SANITIZATION.md).

Builds use this checked-in source, never a sibling checkout or mutable branch.
Changes to this dependency require a separate reviewed dependency update.
